title: Spain · Root order
status: Target formation. Runtime consolidation is pending.

roles.title: King of Spain
owns: Keep Gluck informed and carry decisions
roles.boundary: Officers coordinate directly. Work without an assigned owner escalates here instead of acquiring another hidden standing role.

roles.title: Engineer
owns: Commission research before implementation when needed
roles.boundary: This is the systems Engineer, not the Figaro Engineer. Its only standing staff here are Major and Zanni / Topo.

roles.title: Major
owns: Research techniques and file evaluation requirements through Engineer
roles.boundary: Volts are automations, not officers. Major builds and maintains the mechanism rather than manually making every prediction.

roles.title: Zanni / Topo
roles.summary: All UI, shared components and system maps
owns: All UI changes across the platform
Keel UI, TV UI and site UI coordination
roles.boundary: One UI owner. Backend and infrastructure officers keep their systems; Zanni commissions and integrates their interface work.

roles.title: Figaro Engineer
owns: The terminal pager and input system
roles.boundary: Forms, ebac and figscope are bodies of work handled by transient tail forks, not extra standing staff. UI changes go through Zanni.

roles.title: Quartermaster
roles.boundary: Supply sourced capacity data, not invented balances. King owns production-threshold policy; Zanni owns its UI.

roles.title: Inspector General
owns: Periodic Nix and Home Manager coherence audits
Prepare appropriate rollback work under existing deployment authority
roles.boundary: Audit and commission fixes without becoming a second deployment lane or a review gate on every routine change.

roles.title: El Zapador
roles.boundary: Health alerting is not the Figaro terminal pager. Monitoring and thermal work use transient forks, not a separate standing Vigía. Existing deployment and no-reboot rules still apply.

roles.title: El Taller
roles.boundary: Keel UI belongs to Zanni. Split CI work from API/CLI and review-capability work using separate transient tail forks.

roles.title: Big TV
owns: Coordinate backend verification and device evidence
roles.boundary: Backend, infrastructure and QA work use transient tail forks. All player, receiver and remote UI changes go through Zanni.

roles.title: El Escribano
owns: Commission bounded writing or publishing tasks
roles.boundary: Keep this standing officer. Site UI changes go through Zanni; content and publishing stay here.
